user.title: Connect to Helm
user.description: Create a credential in Helm under Settings → Account → API credentials. The token is shown only once, at creation.

data_description.base_url: Your Helm server's versioned API root, ending in /api/v1
data_description.api_token: The full token, starting with helm_.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Helm
reauth_confirm.description: The credential for {base_url} is no longer accepted. Issue a new one in Helm under Settings → Account → API credentials and paste it below.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Helm API. Check the base URL and that the server is up.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. It may be unknown, revoked, expired, or owned by a child account.
error.rate_limited: Helm is rate limiting this connection. Wait a minute and try again.
error.no_abilities: The token authenticated but carries none of the planning:read, shopping:read or shopping:write abilities.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Helm server is already configured.

data.qty_in_summary: Show quantity in shopping list item names

data_description.days_ahead: How far forward the calendars and sensors keep data cached.
data_description.days_past: How far back to keep data cached, for looking at what already happened.
data_description.update_interval: How often to poll Helm. Each poll uses six requests against a 60/minute limit.
data_description.qty_in_summary: Appends ×2 to an item's name, and reads a trailing ×2 back into the quantity when you add or rename an item.
data_description.show_people: Adds names to event titles on the Schedule and per-type calendars. Per-person calendars never need it, so they are left alone.

add_shopping_item.name: Add shopping item
add_shopping_item.description: Adds an item to the shared shopping list, including the fields the to-do card cannot set.

config_entry_id.name: Helm account
config_entry_id.description: Which Helm connection to use. Give this or an entity.

entity_id.name: Helm entity
entity_id.description: Any entity from the Helm connection to use, instead of naming the connection itself.

shopping_list_type_id.name: Category ID
shopping_list_type_id.description: A shopping list category belonging to the same household.

url.name: URL
url.description: A link to attach to the item.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Replay guard. Reusing a key with the same body returns the original item instead of creating a duplicate.

update_shopping_item.name: Update shopping item
update_shopping_item.description: Updates one shopping list item. Only the fields you supply are sent.

config_entry_id.name: Helm account
config_entry_id.description: Which Helm connection to use. Give this or an entity.

entity_id.name: Helm entity
entity_id.description: Any entity from the Helm connection to use, instead of naming the connection itself.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: The item's Helm ID, visible in the shopping list sensor attributes.

name.name: Name
name.description: A new name for the item.

completed.name: Completed
completed.description: Tick or untick the item. Sending only this field works even for accounts that may tick but not edit.

visible_to_extended.name: Visible to extended family
visible_to_extended.description: Whether extended family can see this item.

delete_shopping_item.name: Delete shopping item
delete_shopping_item.description: Removes one item from the shared shopping list.

config_entry_id.name: Helm account
config_entry_id.description: Which Helm connection to use. Give this or an entity.

entity_id.name: Helm entity
entity_id.description: Any entity from the Helm connection to use, instead of naming the connection itself.

get_planning.name: Get planning
get_planning.description: Returns planning occurrences for a date range. Ranges longer than 31 days are chunked automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Helm account
config_entry_id.description: Which Helm connection to use. Give this or an entity.

entity_id.name: Helm entity
entity_id.description: Any entity from the Helm connection to use, instead of naming the connection itself.

from.name: From
from.description: First day of the range. Defaults to today in the household's timezone.

to.name: To
to.description: Last day of the range, inclusive. Defaults to the from date.

types.name: Types
types.description: Limit the result to certain occurrence types. Defaults to all of them.

token_expiring.title: Helm credential expiring soon
token_expiring.description: The Helm credential "{credential}" used by {name} expires at {expires_at}. Issue a new one in Helm under Settings → Account → API credentials, then reconfigure the integration to avoid losing your calendars and shopping list.
